Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 7  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly categorized "Cantora 1" and "Cantora 2" as studio albums. These albums are collaborative works featuring various artists, which likely qualify them as compilation albums rather than studio albums. As per the task requirements, only studio albums should be counted, and the misclassification led to the wrong conclusion that Mercedes Sosa released two studio albums in the 2000–2009 window. This oversight directly impacted the accuracy of the solution to the real-world problem.
